decisions.name: South Holtburg Outpost
decisions.reason: A real starter outpost (Life Stone, well, shop, cottage, a green-lit Empyrean hall and a 31 m spire tower) in a forest hollow 623 m from Holtburg's filmed hilltop and outside any existing frame. One high establishing shot.

decisions.name: West Holtburg Outpost
decisions.reason: Real outpost, the twin of South Holtburg (shop, lantern hall, Life Stone, Empyrean hall and spire tower on the hill), 695 m from holtburg.02. It gets the opposite, downward east-facing treatment.

decisions.name: Festival Stone of Evensong
decisions.reason: The stone and its glow stand on the River Prosper shore. A 100 m line of temple ruins stands in the river (bamboo, a brick ruin, a gateway of four 10 m wall blocks around a monolithic head rock). Water plus glow, matching acpedia exactly.

decisions.name: Access to Crystal Mines
decisions.reason: Only the Holtburg-side access portal is in the kit: a swirl and Tornash on a bare hilltop at z 129. The acpedia floating platforms (70.5N 8.1W, landblock 0x75D7) are missing from the kit and are not filmed. One rank-3 static.

decisions.name: Edelbar
decisions.reason: A ruined Aluvian village. The hilltop Life Stone has an ancient column and a diagonal row of broken Empyrean pillar stubs leading to a candle sentinel, which matches the acpedia statue and pillar row. Abandoned cottages lie below. Landblocks east of x 30912 are missing, so cameras stay west.

decisions.name: Power Plant
decisions.reason: A large Empyrean temple complex in the Tiofor Woods: an octagon spire hall ringed by twelve moss-green ranges of up to six storeys. It is 4.6 km from any covered shot and spectacular.

decisions.name: Hilltop Tower
decisions.reason: A 31 m Empyrean spire tower on the highest summit south of Holtburg, with a drudge campfire and 32 m pines around it; gazetteer drop point 23 m away.

decisions.name: Fort Witshire
decisions.reason: A 72 m square fort on a raised plateau: four 31 m corner spire towers, curtain walls, a barricaded east gate and the central cottage-keep. It is 2.4 km from any covered shot.

decisions.name: Heartland
decisions.reason: The real Heartland portal drop farmstead: two stone cottages with brass lanterns and cows in a grassy hollow. Small, so one rank-3 dronie.

decisions.name: Festival Stone of Thistledown
decisions.reason: The stone stands on the bluff between two ancient columns topped with fire bowls and overlooks Cragstone Falls, as acpedia says. Its pedestal reveals the falls over the bluff edge.

decisions.name: Cragstone Falls
decisions.reason: A 90 m-wide waterfall (14 lip and 24 foot Waterfall emitters) dropping 22-26 m from the river plateau into Victory Bay, with a bamboo fishing hut. It is 1.3 km from cragstone.03. This is the batch's best water feature.

decisions.name: Drudge Fort
decisions.reason: A 210 m hilltop fort of concentric timber palisades with four wooden towers, 24 gate torches and bonfires. cragstone.03 is 480 m away but frames the windmill, not the fort.

decisions.name: Asheron's Castle
decisions.reason: The castle on Asheron's Island mountain top (z 374): towers, a red spire and a 90 m minaret above 300 m cliffs. It is not a tour town and eastham.01 faces away from it. Kit landblocks to the west and north are missing, so cameras stay south and east.

decisions.name: Riverbend Tower
decisions.reason: A 19 m Empyrean stone tower on a terrace above the River Prosper, with the Riverbend drop point and the Renegade Stronghold portal nearby. It is 2.7 km from any covered shot.

decisions.name: East Rithwic Outpost
decisions.reason: A destroyed starter outpost with a Life Stone, a 28 m ruined Empyrean monument tower and cottages. rithwic.05 (470 m away) films a different ruin, the Destroyed Portal to Greenspire.

decisions.name: South Rithwic Outpost
decisions.reason: A destroyed outpost with a Life Stone, a cottage among oaks and the monument tower on a rise. It is 709 m from rithwic.02 and not framed there. One rank-3 reveal.

decisions.name: East Lytelthorpe Outpost
decisions.reason: A destroyed outpost. The acpedia row of Empyrean pillars toward the Forgotten Temple is real (eight 4.6 m pillars over 350 m), and the Destroyed Portal to Bluespire carries tesla lightning FX. It is 666 m from lytelthorpe.07.

decisions.name: West Lytelthorpe Outpost
decisions.reason: A destroyed outpost on a terrace with the monument tower, an apple orchard, a Life Stone and a small fountain. It is 648 m from lytelthorpe.06.

decisions.name: Festival Stone of Seedsow
decisions.reason: The stone stands on a forest knoll inside a cross of mossy candle sentinels with blue flames, as acpedia describes ('in the woods west of Lytelthorpe'). It is small and photogenic, filmed with the batch's rack focus.

decisions.name: Frest Greelving's Mansion
decisions.reason: The surface mansion is real: four gothic buildings including a 31 m black clock tower on a bare hilltop, with dead antler trees and a glowing pumpkin. It is 2.1 km from any covered shot. Only the exterior is filmed.

decisions.name: Rithwic Festival Grounds
decisions.reason: Real festival grounds: two octagon tents, red pennants, candle-lit running-track arches, a dance canvas and chessboards, 1.1 km from rithwic.02. The Leafdawning stone 163 m east belongs to batch 1 and is avoided as a subject.
